rows.grounds: numeral base of compound indicating quantity
locative plural expressing location within a vast number
compound of yoni and yantra in locative plural denoting realms or mechanisms of birth
past passive participle describing those subjected to suffering

items.question: What condition afflicts beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: The scope encompasses eighty-four thousand instances.
These instances are womb-diagrams as loci of existence.
Beings within them are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment throughout the vast multitude of womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The implied subject of pīḍitāḥ is supplied from context as beings or souls.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
